requirements.invariant: Checkpoint only at declared compatible semantic synchronization boundaries.
Payload bytes are durable and digest-verified before metadata becomes authoritative.
Manifest publication, current pointer and event advance atomically in one local authoritative transaction.
Checkpoint sequence is strictly monotonic and stale-fence writers cannot advance it.
Manifest records monotonic decision-history and external-effect watermarks sufficient for replay boundary decisions.
Orphan payload cleanup requires reference scan plus safety window.
Checkpoint deletion/retention defers to 021M and preserves hold/evidence obligations.
